paragraphs: The SLC250 is part of the R172-generation SLC, produced from 2016 to 2020. It uses the M270 or M274 — a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder petrol engine, shared across a wide range of Mercedes models of that era, including the C-Class. The SLC was the successor to the SLK and has been discontinued with no direct replacement — but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every SLC250 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the SLC250 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The SLC250 uses the M270/M274 4-cylinder petrol family across its entire 2016–2020 production run. The R172 generation was the only SLC generation, so there are no chassis-crossing compatibility concerns — but confirming your exact engine code still matters for parts specification.
